body:
## What

Every PDF produced in RT **demo mode** now carries a visible diagonal **DEMO** watermark (user ruling 2026-08-24: "the PDF files in DEMO should have watermarks saying demo"). Nothing produced in demo mode can be mistaken for a real document.

## Producer survey (rule 2 — every PDF path, grepped)

| # | Producer | Demo-reachable? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ai/audit_report.gleam::generate` — the **central** Typst renderer (`typst compile` → `priv/templates/audit_report.typ`), serving `GET /api/v1/ai/analyses/:id/pdf` via `ai_report_handler` | **No** — the demo SPA intercepts the download client-side (`demo_update` → `demo_api.download` → static asset); the route never fires in demo mode | **Watermarked (seam)** — `generate(watermark: False)`; no watermark argv, output byte-identical (pinned) |
| 2 | `demo/pdf_prebake.gleam` (build-time) → `server/priv/static/demo/report-*.pdf` — the demo's **only** PDF download path (`/static/demo/report-<id>.pdf`) | **Yes** — all 8 pre-baked reports | **Watermarked** — `generate(watermark: True)`; all 8 re-baked + committed |
| 3 | `server/priv/static/templates/rtb-sample-tenancy-agreement.pdf` (RTB's own sample, linked from SPA resources + content pages) | both modes, identical | **Excluded** — third-party static asset, not generated by RT, identical in both modes |
| 4 | `server/priv/static/templates/tenant-vetting-checklist.pdf` (marketing content page) | content pages only | **Excluded** — static asset built from `tenant-vetting-checklist.typ`, not part of the demo flow |
| 5 | DSAR export (`dsar/dsar_handler.gleam`) | no | **Excluded** — JSON export, not PDF |
| 6 | Demo applicant documents (`demo_store` `storage_path: "demo/<id>/…pdf"`) | simulated uploads | **Excluded** — no PDF bytes are generated or served; the hrefs resolve to non-existent files (404) |
| 7 | `payment@invoice_cache_ffi` | — | **Excluded** — ETS cache of RTB invoice JSON, not a PDF |
| 8 | Client-side PDF generation | — | **Excluded** — no PDF libs in the client bundle |

## The seam (rule 4)

The codebase **has** a central PDF renderer — `audit_report.generate` → the shared Typst template. One seam, both producers:

- `generate(data:, priv_dir:, watermark: Bool)` — when `True`, appends `--input watermark=true` to the typst argv; when `False` the argv is **identical** to the pre-change pipeline.
- `audit_report.typ` — a `demo-watermark` layer (`DEMO`, DM Sans 700, 64pt, muted-red at 25% alpha, rotated 40°, centered) attached to the page background of **every** page, plus an explicit `place` at the end of the cover block (the cover paints a full-bleed navy block over the background). When the flag is absent the layer resolves to `none` — verified byte-identical.
- Callers: runtime handler → `watermark: False`; demo pre-bake → `watermark: True`.

## Sample render

![DEMO watermark on demo report pages](_bmad-output/demo-pdf-watermark/watermark-sample.png)

Left: aoife cover · middle: aoife interior p3 · right: liam cover. Rendered from the actual committed demo PDFs; vision-verified (diagonal, semi-transparent, no content obstruction).

## Tests (acceptance)

- `pdf_real_mode_render_matches_golden_test` — real-mode render (`watermark: False`) is **byte-identical** to a committed golden compiled from the pre-watermark template (metadata noise — creation timestamps + random document instance ID — normalized via `ai@audit_report_ffi.normalize_metadata`).
- `pdf_demo_watermark_renders_test` — same payload: `watermark: True` output differs from `False` beyond metadata noise (watermark is real page content).
- `demo_reports_carry_watermark_on_two_distinct_paths_test` — **two distinct demo PDF paths** (a-aoife multi-page showcase, a-liam short report) carry the watermark.
- Mutation-verified: disabling the watermark layer fails exactly the two presence tests; corrupting the golden fails the identity test.

`make format` / `make test` (1533 pass) / `make build` / repo lints (let-assert, httpc, demo-network) all green.

## Decisions & rationale

- **Flag on `generate`, not a second demo detector** (rule 1): the canonical demo check is client-side (`model.demo_mode` — landed by #636); the server has no demo mode. The pre-bake tool *is* the demo producer, so the flag is passed at its single call site — no second detector invented.
- **Metadata normalization, not `--creation-timestamp`**: pinning typst's clock would change real-mode PDF metadata for everyone; instead the test strips the compile-varying fields and compares everything else byte-for-byte. The normalizer covers all eight byte patterns empirically observed across compiles: `/CreationDate` + `/ModDate` (info dict and XMP forms), `xmpMM:InstanceID`, the trailer `/ID` pair, the xref offset rows (`\d{10} 00000 n`) and `startxref`. The xref offsets are pure file-position bookkeeping and must be normalized because they shift with file length.
- **CI fix (r1, run 32736104915)**: the golden test failed on ubuntu while passing on macOS. Root cause reproduced with the exact CI binary (`typst 0.14.2` linux-musl in Docker): macOS typst emits timezone-suffixed `CreationDate`/`ModDate` (`+01'00`, 21 chars), the linux-musl build emits UTC with no suffix (16 chars) — a 10-byte length delta that shifted every xref offset. The normalized content bytes were otherwise identical. Fix: the normalizer additionally strips the xref offset rows + `startxref` (pure bookkeeping — no content bytes are matched). Verified by (a) rendering the golden payload with the CI binary and confirming `normalize(linux) == normalize(golden)`, (b) an end-to-end swap test running the real Gleam suite against a linux-rendered golden (1533 pass), (c) re-running the golden-corruption mutation (still fails) and the watermark-layer mutation (still fails).
- **25% alpha, muted-red, 40°**: chosen from three alpha variants (15/25/35%) via vision review — visible at a glance on both the navy cover and white interiors, unobtrusive to read through.
- **Golden re-bless policy**: a legitimate template change that alters real-mode output requires a deliberate re-bless of `server/test/fixtures/real_mode_report_golden.pdf` (same discipline as the demo PDFs).
- **bmad-build waiver (canon note)**: the briefing's skills policy names `bmad-quick-dev`, which forwards to `bmad-build`; that render path is broken on this install (`ambiguous config token implementation_artifacts` — `_bmad/config.toml` + `_bmad/bmm/config.yaml` both define it; no `_bmad/scripts/render_skill.py`). Waived per the standing Silas ruling (2026-08-21) — the briefing was already a complete self-contained spec and was executed as such.
- **Demo document uploads excluded**: their storage hrefs point at files that do not exist server-side; no bytes are produced for them in either mode (out of scope of "PDFs produced in demo mode").



## Perkins r1 fixes (review 5008933590 — B1, B2, W1, W2)

- **B1 — handler flag pinned (was unasserted):** `ai_report_handler` now exposes `build_report_data/3` + `load_application_snapshot/3` (public, used by the handler itself), and the integration test `pdf_real_mode_route_serves_unwatermarked_report_test` rebuilds the identical ReportData from the seeded rows and asserts the **served body** equals `generate(watermark: False)` and differs from `generate(watermark: True)` (metadata-normalized). Mutation-verified: flipping the handler's flag to `watermark: True` fails exactly this test (549 passed, 1 failed).
- **B2/W2 — committed demo bytes pinned:** `committed_demo_pdfs_match_fresh_rebake_test` re-renders **all eight** committed `server/priv/static/demo/report-*.pdf` through the real pipeline (`watermark: True`) and compares metadata-normalized. A stale bake — payload fixture edited without re-baking, or the watermark layer reverted — now fails CI. Mutation-verified: restoring the pre-rebake (double-layer) liam PDF fails exactly this test.
- **W1 — cover double layer removed (was real):** mechanically confirmed via background-only / place-only / both variant renders + pixel diff: `background_only` and `place_only` render identically (one 25% layer); `both` composites to 43.75% (two stacked 25% layers, pixel (93,52,74) vs (64,47,74)). The page background renders above the full-bleed cover block, so the explicit cover `place` was redundant — removed, template comment corrected. All 8 PDFs re-baked (cover now 25%, consistent with interiors; pixel-verified (64,44,72) dominant) and the sample render refreshed (vision-verified consistent weight across cover + interior).
title: feat(demo): watermark every demo PDF with diagonal DEMO
